modification_description: Structured uncertainty disclosure should be strengthened with two guardrails: (1) proportionality to clinical risk and urgency, where disclosure depth scales with how much uncertainty affects patient decisions and immediate treatment contexts may warrant lighter framing; (2) making uncertainty operationally concrete by explaining what is unknown, what is known, specific timelines, safety-net instructions, who will follow up, and checking patient preferences for how much detail they want when feasible.
